title: Credit Ruling: Disconnect Notice Clearance and the Starting Share of a Reinstated Security Deposits Installment
content:
**Applies to:** the first installment of a Security Deposits deposit reinstated on the waiver reinstatement basis while the service account it secures waits to be reconnected after a nonpayment disconnection.

## Ruling

The share starts from the record of the outstanding disconnect notice on the Electric Service by Rate Schedule account the reinstated deposit secures. When the service payments posted on the account less than one whole month before today reach the past-due amount the outstanding disconnect notice demands, the share starts at the cleared-notice share of **30 percent**. When those payments reach at least half of that amount but less than all of it, the share starts at the half-cleared share of **40 percent**. Below half, and always where no notice is outstanding, this ruling sets no starting share.

## Reading the records

- **Past-due amount demanded:** the disconnect notice past-due amount shown on the Electric Service by Rate Schedule account. An account showing no such amount above zero has no outstanding notice.
- **Service payments counted:** the payments posted on that account less than one whole month before today, added together. Energy assistance pledges and returned-payment entries are not payments for this count.
- **Reach:** payments equal to the past-due amount reach it.

## Ladder

| Payments posted in the last whole month, against the notice's past-due amount | Starting share |
|---|---|
| at least the whole past-due amount | 30 percent |
| at least half of it, but less than all of it | 40 percent |
| less than half of it | not set by this ruling |
| no notice outstanding | not set by this ruling |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical notice demanding $240.00)

| Payments in the last whole month | Starting share |
|---|---|
| $240.00 | 30 percent |
| $239.99 | 40 percent |
| $120.00 | 40 percent |
| $119.99 | not set by this ruling |
